_: Favour given makes rivals (rivalry.js; CK3's jealous rivals, docs/TENSION.md 'someone loses'): when an order warms a great house by min or more, its rival cools by share of it (rounded, at least 1); a rival at war with it takes it as aid to its foe and cools by warShare (Mac 2026-11-16: 'if they are at war, why am I sending food?'). Its rival: the great house it is at war with, else the great house whose seat lies nearest its own. word / warWord: what an order's label says, {rival} the rival's name.
